newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Centennial up 14.14 pct in mid-morning.
newsitem.headline: Centennial up 14.14 pct in mid-morning.

text.p: Centennial City Inc rose 14.14 percent to 2.26 pesos by mid-morning on Monday on talk that a review ordered on the controversial Manila Bay project, in which City is involved, would soon be completed, brokers said.
Centennial has a 20 percent stake in the Thai-Philippine Amari consortium, which has proposed a 750-hectare reclamation project in Manila Bay.
A senator had questioned the award to Amari by the Public Estates Authority, saying the property was undervalued.
In December, President Fidel Ramos ordered a review of the all contracts for the Manila Bay real estate development project.
